item.title: MS International secures anti-drone contract with NATO country
item.summary: MS International has secured a €19.4 million contract to supply three naval gun systems to an unnamed NATO country, strengthening its position in the growing market for counter-drone defence. The contract, awarded to its Norwich-based subsidiary MSI Defence Systems, covers three 30mm gun systems designed to protect naval vessels against uncrewed aerial systems as well […] The post MS International secures anti-drone contract with NATO country appeared first on UK Investor Magazine .
